fault_semantics: a faulting stripe zeroes its own outputs at once and the sticky store fault raises `fault` (programme-stripe faults 1 edge after r7c, IO faults on the r7c edge); stripes that have not faulted keep emitting their words until the host acts on `fault` (r7c zeroed all stripes); the host must not launch again after a fault (as r7c)
